<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" id="definitions" targetNamespace="http://example.org/bpmn">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="collaboration">
    <bpmn:participant id="POOL" name="Bicycle manufacturer" processRef="PROCESS" />
  </bpmn:collaboration>
  <bpmn:process id="PROCESS" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LANES">
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_SALES" name="Sales department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>start_order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>decide_order</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_accept</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_rejected</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>inform_parties</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>fork</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>ship_bike</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>end_finished</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_STORE" name="Storehouse">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>process_part_list</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>check_quantity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_available</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>reserve_part</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>backorder_part</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>merge_items</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>gw_more_items</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="LANE_ENG" name="Engineering department">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>prepare_assembly</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>join</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>assemble_bike</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>
    <bpmn:startEvent id="start_order" name="Order received" />
    <bpmn:task id="decide_order" name="Accept or reject the order" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_accept" name="Order accepted?" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_rejected" name="Order rejected" />
    <bpmn:task id="inform_parties" name="Inform the storehouse and the engineering department" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="fork" name="Split" />
    <bpmn:task id="process_part_list" name="Process the part list of the order" />
    <bpmn:task id="check_quantity" name="Check the required quantity of each part" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_available" name="Part available in-house?" />
    <bpmn:task id="reserve_part" name="Reserve the part" />
    <bpmn:task id="backorder_part" name="Back-order the part" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="merge_items" name="Merge" />
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="gw_more_items" name="More items on the part list?" />
    <bpmn:task id="prepare_assembly" name="Prepare the assembling of the bicycle" />
    <bpmn:parallelGateway id="join" name="Join" />
    <bpmn:task id="assemble_bike" name="Assemble the bicycle" />
    <bpmn:task id="ship_bike" name="Ship the bicycle to the customer" />
    <bpmn:endEvent id="end_finished" name="Process instance finished" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f1" sourceRef="start_order" targetRef="decide_order" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f2" sourceRef="decide_order" targetRef="gw_accept" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f3" name="rejected" sourceRef="gw_accept" targetRef="end_rejected" />

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f11" name="not available" sourceRef="gw_available" targetRef="backorder_part" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f12" sourceRef="reserve_part" targetRef="merge_items" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f13" sourceRef="backorder_part" targetRef="merge_items" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="f14" sourceRef="merge_items" targetRef="gw_more_items" />
